metadata.description: Etienne Pasteur's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: angular
plugins.description: Angular development tooling. Bundles the official angular-developer skill (vendored from angular/angular, MIT) plus the ngx-translate-xlsx skill for externalizing UI strings into @ngx-translate keys backed by an Excel sheet.

plugins.name: flipper-claude-buddy
plugins.description: Turns a Flipper Zero into a physical remote and feedback device for Claude Code: sound, vibration and display on notifications, permission prompts answered from the device, and button-to-keystroke forwarding over USB or BLE. Vendored from a fork carrying a security hardening patch (private runtime dir, 0600 IPC socket).
